content.subject: Need help after what happened last Thursday
content.body:
Hi, I was given your name by a friend from my church group and I wanted to see if you could help me. Last Thursday I got hurt pretty bad and I am still trying to figure out what to do. I went to urgent care that night and they told me I have a fracture in my left wrist and a lot of bruising on my hip and lower back. They want me to follow up with an orthopedist this week.

It happened in the middle of the afternoon. I had just finished running an errand and the next thing I really remember clearly is a man in a green polo helping me sit up on the ground and asking if I needed an ambulance. I told him no because I was embarrassed and I just wanted to get home. My daughter drove me to urgent care a couple hours later when the swelling got bad.

I have been off work since Friday because I cannot really use my hand and the pain medication makes me sleepy. My supervisor at Copper Ridge Staffing has been understanding so far but I do not know how long that lasts. I am a single parent and missing shifts is not something I can do for very long.

I was hoping someone there could tell me what my options are and what information you need from me to get started. I have the urgent care paperwork and a couple of pictures my daughter took of the bruising. Please let me know what the next step is. Thank you for your time.

Marisol Tavares
